name: VerTrace
description: Fixed questions, evidence annotations, versioned software-documentation corpora, split assignments, stored rankings, evaluation code and CPU replay for six sources: Node.js, Kubernetes, GitHub REST OpenAPI, Django, PostgreSQL and Python. The current evaluation contract contains 736 questions, including 152 test questions and 120 chain-applicable test questions, and 227879 corpus chunks. The archive includes a rendered resource guide and its compilable sources. Model weights and the manuscript are not included. Original contributions use CC BY 4.0; software uses Apache-2.0; upstream material retains its own licenses and notices. Stored model responses are evaluation evidence, without a separate assertion of author-held copyright. License scope The archive is a mixed-license collection. Each license applies only to its stated components; the licenses are not alternatives for the whole archive. Preserved source notices remain authoritative. CC-BY-4.0: Original questions, evidence annotations and authored resource documentation only; upstream excerpts and model responses are excluded from the author grant. Kubernetes documentation separately uses upstream CC BY 4.0 with its recorded attribution. Apache-2.0: Software implementation; preserve repository/LICENSE and notices. MIT: Node.js documentation and GitHub API descriptions, subject to the preserved release-specific and component notices. BSD-3-Clause: Django documentation; preserve its copyright, conditions and disclaimer.
